description: Noise generator producing white or pink noise for as long as a gate is high

params.text: Chooses white noise in the upper position and pink noise in the lower

inputs.text: Lets the noise through while the voltage here is 1.7V or above, and holds the output at 0V below that

outputs.text: The noise, white or pink as the switch is set, and 0V while the gate is below 1.7V

notes: No noise comes out until a gate of 1.7V or more reaches GATE; with nothing patched there the output holds 0V.
